56128-the-cottage-on-the-fells.title: The Cottage On The Fells
56128-the-cottage-on-the-fells.creator: Unknown
56128-the-cottage-on-the-fells.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Comyns was handsome, Comyns was wealthy. His father made bicycle lamps and motor horns in Wolverhampton, his grandfather had been a platelayer. He belonged to one of those families that go up in the world. Hellier belonged to one of the families that go down. When Comyns’ grandfather had been laying plate, Hellier’s had been eating off it.

arxiv-2104-14610.title: STDP and the distribution of preferred phases in the whisker system
arxiv-2104-14610.creator: Nimrod Sherf
arxiv-2104-14610.description: Abstract Abstract Rats and mice use their whiskers to probe the environment. By rhythmically swiping their whiskers back and forth they can detect the existence of an object, locate it, and identify its texture. Localization can be accomplished by inferring the whisker’s position.

arxiv-2105-01972.title: Mpemba effect in anisotropically driven inelastic Maxwell gases
arxiv-2105-01972.creator: Apurba Biswas, V. V. Prasad, R. Rajesh
arxiv-2105-01972.description: Abstract Through an exact analysis, we show the existence of Mpemba effect in an anisotropically driven inelastic Maxwell gas, a simplified model for granular gases, in two dimensions. Mpemba effect refers to the couterintuitive phenomenon of a hotter system relaxing to the steady state faster than a cooler system, when both are quenched to the same lower temperature.

arxiv-2109-09019.title: Complex geodesics in tube domains and their role in the study of harmonic mappings in the disc
arxiv-2109-09019.creator: Włodzimierz Zwonek
arxiv-2109-09019.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Włodzimierz Zwonek. We continue the research on the structure of complex geodesics in tube domains over (bounded) convex bases. In some special cases a more explicit form of the geodesics than the existing ones are provided. As one of the consequences of our study an effective formula for the Kobayashi-Royden metric in the tube domain T 𝔹 n T_{\mathbb{B}_{n}} at the origin is given. The results on the Kobayashi-Royden metric in a natural way provide versions of the Schwarz Lemma for harmonic mappings.

arxiv-2204-14011.title: An approximation of the Bayesian state observer with Markov chain Monte Carlo propagation stage footnoteinfo This work has been supported by the COMET-K2 Center of the Linz Center of Mechatronics (LCM) funded by the Austrian federal government and the federal state of Upper Austria.
arxiv-2204-14011.creator: L. Ecker, K. Schlacher
arxiv-2204-14011.description: Abstract The state estimation problem for nonlinear systems with stochastic uncertainties can be formulated in the Bayesian framework, where the objective is to replace the state completely by its probability density function. Without the restriction to selected system classes and disturbance properties, the Bayesian estimator is particularly interesting for highly nonlinear systems with non-Gaussian noise.

arxiv-2211-16068.title: ACE: Cooperative Multi-agent Q-learning with Bidirectional Action-Dependency
arxiv-2211-16068.creator: Chuming Li, Jie Liu, Yinmin Zhang, Yuhong Wei, Yazhe Niu, Yaodong Yang
arxiv-2211-16068.description: Abstract Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) suffers from the non-stationarity problem, which is the ever-changing targets at every iteration when multiple agents update their policies at the same time. Starting from first principle, in this paper, we manage to solve the non-stationarity problem by proposing bidirectional action-dependent Q-learning (ACE).

arxiv-2304-02769.title: Low-Shot Learning for Fictional Claim Verification
arxiv-2304-02769.creator: Viswanath Chadalapaka, Derek Nguyen, JoonWon Choi, Shaunak Joshi, Mohammad Rostami
arxiv-2304-02769.description: Abstract In this paper, we study the problem of claim verification in the context of claims about fictional stories in a low-shot learning setting. To this end, we generate two synthetic datasets and then develop an end-to-end pipeline and model that is tested on both benchmarks.

arxiv-2406-04414.title: Smooth nonradial stationary Euler flows on the plane with compact support
arxiv-2406-04414.creator: Alberto Enciso, Antonio J. Fernández, David Ruiz
arxiv-2406-04414.description: Abstract . We prove the existence of nonradial classical solutions to the 2D incompressible Euler equations with compact support. More precisely, for any positive integer k k , we construct compactly supported stationary Euler flows of class C k ​ ( ℝ 2 ) C^{k}(\mathbb{R}^{2}) which are not locally radial.

arxiv-2409-08527.title: EHC-MM: Embodied Holistic Control for Mobile Manipulation
arxiv-2409-08527.creator: Jiawen Wang, Yixiang Jin, Jun Shi, Yong A, Dingzhe Li, Fuchun Sun, Dingsheng Luo, Bin Fang
arxiv-2409-08527.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jiawen Wang, Yixiang Jin, Jun Shi, Yong A, Dingzhe Li, Fuchun Sun, Dingsheng Luo, Bin Fang. Mobile manipulation typically entails the base for mobility, the arm for accurate manipulation, and the camera for perception. The principle of Distant Mobility, Close Grasping (DMCG) is essential for holistic control.

arxiv-2409-10188.title: Enhancing RL Safety with Counterfactual LLM Reasoning
arxiv-2409-10188.creator: Dennis Gross, Helge Spieker
arxiv-2409-10188.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) policies may exhibit unsafe behavior and are hard to explain. We use counterfactual large language model reasoning to enhance RL policy safety post-training. We show that our approach improves and helps to explain the RL policy safety. 1 Introduction Reinforcement learning (RL) has transformed technology [ 19 ] .

arxiv-2510-12804.creator: Ya Gao †,∗

arxiv-2512-03156.title: High-angular-resolution ALMA imaging of the inhomogeneous dynamical atmosphere of the asymptotic giant branch star W Hya Preprint: K. Ohnaka
arxiv-2512-03156.creator: K. Ohnaka, K. T. Wong, G. Weigelt, K.-H. Hofmann
arxiv-2512-03156.description: Abstract Aims. We present high-angular-resolution imaging of the asymptotic giant branch star W Hya with the Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array (ALMA) to probe the dynamics and chemistry in the atmosphere and inner wind. Methods. W Hya was observed with the longest baselines of ALMA at 250–268 GHz with an angular resolution of ∼ \sim 17 × \times 20 mas. Results.

arxiv-2512-22834.title: Physical constraints on the MSS chaos-bound in black hole spacetimes
arxiv-2512-22834.creator: Terkaa Victor Targema, Kazuharu Bamba, Riasat Ali, Usman Zafar
arxiv-2512-22834.description: Abstract Chaotic motion near black holes has recently been examined through the lens of the Maldacena-Shenker-Stanford (MSS) chaos-bound, but reported violations remain contradictory. A major source of this ambiguity lies in the common practice of treating the angular momentum of test particles as a freely adjustable parameter, rather than a quantity fixed by the circular-orbit conditions.

pmc-11596295.title: DiMA: sequence diversity dynamics analyser for viruses
pmc-11596295.creator: Shan Tharanga, Eyyüb Selim Ünlü, Yongli Hu, Muhammad Farhan Sjaugi, Muhammet A Çelik, Hilal Hekimoğlu, Olivo Miotto, Muhammed Miran Öncel, Asif M Khan
pmc-11596295.description: Sequence diversity is one of the major challenges in the design of diagnostic, prophylactic, and therapeutic interventions against viruses. DiMA is a novel tool that is big data-ready and designed to facilitate the dissection of sequence diversity dynamics for viruses. DiMA stands out from other diversity analysis tools by offering various unique features.

pmc-12437768.title: Findings from RCT’s on virtual reality-based interventions for auditory hallucinations and paranoia
pmc-12437768.creator: L Birkedal Glenthøj, M Nordentoft
pmc-12437768.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Abstract: IntroductionVirtual reality (VR) has the potential to enhance current psychotherapies for psychotic symptoms by simulating virtual environments that evoke responses reflective of real-world scenarios.ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of VR-based psychotherapeutic interventions through findings from two large-scale randomized clinical trials—CHALLENGE and Face Your Fears—that targeted auditory hallucinations (AH) and paranoia, respectively, in individuals with schizophrenia spectrum disorders (SSD).MethodThe CHALLENGE and Face Your Fears trials were randomized, assessor-blinded, parallel-group superiority trials that enrolled 270 and 254 patients with SSD, respectively.

pmc-12575813.title: Impact of snow manipulation on overwintering disease and frost damage across pasture grass species
pmc-12575813.creator: Seiji Shimoda
pmc-12575813.description: Snow manipulation regulates soil temperature, reducing overwintering diseases and supporting pasture growth, though it has a limited effect on supporting grass growth. This study assessed the snow manipulation effects on overwintering damage and disease control in timothy (TY), orchardgrass (OG), and perennial ryegrass (PR).

pmc-12614651.title: Spatially resolved structure-function mapping of the anterior cruciate ligament-bone interface
pmc-12614651.creator: Huizhi Wang, Qingqing Yang, Qinyi Shi, Kaixin He, Wenxin Feng, Li Li, Cheng-Kung Cheng
pmc-12614651.description: AimsTo investigate the spatial distribution of structural features at the anterior cruciate ligament (ACL)-bone interface and examine their relationship with local tensile properties and stress distribution, thereby elucidating the structure-function relationship at this critical soft-hard tissue junction.MethodsHigh-resolution micro-CT was employed to obtain 3D imaging of 17 porcine ACL-femur interface specimens.

pmc-12950719.title: School mental health promotion in Indonesia: a quantitative survey from Surabaya
pmc-12950719.creator: Margaretha Margaretha, Peter S. Azzopardi, Jane Fisher, Susan M. Sawyer
pmc-12950719.description: IntroductionMost young people live in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet little is known about the implementation of school mental health promotion strategies in resource-poor settings. This study describes the extent of school mental health promotion and its drivers in junior high schools in Surabaya, Indonesia.

pmc-12962291.title: The Link Between Syntactic Complexity and Stuttering‐Like Disfluencies in French Speaking Adults
pmc-12962291.creator: Alice Le Dévic, Sascha Diwersy, Ivana Didirková
pmc-12962291.description: BackgroundStuttering is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by speech disfluencies. While studies have shown a link between syntactic complexity and stuttering in children, its role in adults who stutter (AWS) remains unclear. This study investigates whether increased syntactic complexity correlates with stuttering‐like disfluencies (SLDs) in AWS and evaluates three syntactic complexity indices.

pmc-13603768.title: Guanidinoacetic Acid and Cysteamine Hydrochloride Improve Beef Cattle Growth and Antioxidant Capacity via Fecal Microbiome and Serum Metabolome
pmc-13603768.creator: Baoshan Feng, Hongwei Zhang, Jianjun Guo, Meishu Tan, Sen Mao, Bin Yu, Yiran Xu, Yanan Wang, Man Feng, Lianjie Song, Yinghao Zhou, Hongjian Xu
